class.name: AIProximityGrid2D
class.brief_description: Deterministic, bounded spatial neighbor lookup for batches of 2D AI agents.
class.description: Computes radius-neighbor lists for a cohort of 2D points using a temporary uniform spatial grid, visiting at most nine cells per source when the cell size is at least the radius. The method is stateless and returns only input indices; it neither accesses scene nodes nor decides which actors can interact. Coordinates are interpreted in the caller's chosen plane (Albion After uses world XZ mapped to Vector2). Each result is a PackedInt32Array of neighboring input indices in ascending input order; the source index is excluded. The result Array preserves the order and duplicates of source_indices. Distance uses inclusive Euclidean radius. Empty source input returns an empty result. Positions are capped at 8192, sources at 1024; radius must be finite and in [0, 256], cell_size finite and in [max(1, radius), 256], source indices valid, and each position finite and within plus/minus one million on both axes. Invalid input returns an empty array. Do not equate this query with physics collision detection, visibility or a server trust decision.

method.name: query_radius_batch
method.description: Builds a temporary grid and returns one packed neighbor-index list for every source, sorted by original index. The bucket arrangement is never exposed. Rejects oversized or invalid input instead of returning partially computed results.
